item.title: US strikes deal with Taiwan to cut tariffs, boost chip investment
item.description: Taiwan vowed Friday to remain the world’s “most important” AI chipmaker, after reaching a trade deal with the United States that will reduce tariffs on the island’s shipments and increase Taiwanese investment on US soil. item.title: HKFP Monitor Jan 17, 2026: Jimmy Lai trial ignites courtroom queue rivalry
item.description: Welcome back to HKFP Monitor. This week, Apple Daily founder Jimmy Lai returned to court for a mitigation hearing – and, as in other high-profile national security cases, so did his supporters and the “queuing gangs.” HKFP looked at the courtgoers’ strategy to secure courtroom seats for the landmark trial. | HOLDING THE LINE… OR […]

item.title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 66
item.description: In a landmark national security trial, a Hong Kong court convicted pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai of foreign collusion and sedition charges. The guilty verdict, delivered in mid-December, was lauded by Hong Kong and Beijing authorities but condemned by foreign governments and press groups. The authorities also hit back at those criticising the conviction. The […]

item.title: China bids to host secretariat of new high seas treaty days after Trump withdraws US from 66 global orgs
item.description: China on Friday proposed to host the secretariat of a new treaty governing the high seas, a surprise bid that underscores Beijing’s desire to have greater influence over global environmental governance. item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Hong Kong’s dwindling LGBTQ funding scheme mainly goes to groups with no ties to community
item.description: Five of the seven groups awarded funding under a government scheme for projects on sexual minorities have no track record of LGBTQ-related work, prompting concern among veteran activists about their effectiveness. The recipients include groups that organise beach clean-ups and artificial intelligence (AI) classes. Most have apparent pro-establishment ties, an HKFP investigation has found. They […]

item.title: China tells Cambodia scam hub disappearances threaten ties
item.description: China’s embassy in Cambodia said on Saturday that a recent spate of disappearances of Chinese nationals into cyberfraud compounds poses a “serious obstacle” to the allies’ ties. item.description: China’s foreign ministry in Hong Kong has condemned US lawmakers’ calls for Washington to strip the city’s trade offices of their privileges, slamming the move as evidence of “deep-seated ideological bias.” The Commissioner’s Office of the Foreign Ministry in Hong Kong’s comments in a Saturday statement came days after US bipartisan lawmakers reintroduced a bill […]

item.description: Hong Kong police will expand the use of drones for crime prevention to areas including The Peak, Cheung Chau and Lamma Island as part of a pilot scheme. item.title: China’s 2025 economic growth among slowest in decades
item.description: China’s economy grew at one of the slowest rates in decades last year, according to official data released Monday, as officials struggle to overcome persistently low consumer spending and a debt crisis in the country’s property sector.
